scope: Seven original-term field adjudications only; two unchanged numeric/unit fields supported per resolved case. Not whole-record confirmation, verbatim enacted text, current force or full freshness.

records.source_basis: Proposed successor identifies ordinance 1594 and 45 days from adoption; its blank vote and certification leave final version and adoption unproved.
records.remaining_questions: Establish adopted original term or an authoritative record-specific account and resolve final successor wording/adoption; exact original operative text and effect remain separate.

records.source_basis: Retained automated account and tracker do not independently establish the adopted original day count.
records.remaining_questions: Find record-specific reliable evidence of the adopted original term and resolve instrument identity and wording; arithmetic and an automated summary are insufficient.

records.source_basis: The September 15 official planner report directly describes the August 18 adoption of ordinance 559 as a 45-day moratorium; the September 1 packet’s draft minutes separately record the action and five ayes, and the original draft contains 45 days. Together these support the field, though the minutes are not shown approved.
records.remaining_questions: Verify approval or final version of August 18 minutes and exact enacted 559 text, including anchor and effectiveness; the unsigned proposal cannot establish verbatim enacted wording. Review extension and later history separately.

records.source_basis: The proposed 2026-19 successor specifically recites that 2026-18 established a 45-day moratorium, but the retained successor wording is not authenticated as final. Reported extension adoption does not prove the recital survived.
records.remaining_questions: Establish the adopted original term through an authoritative record, or confirm the final adopted successor recital and version; exact original wording and effectiveness remain distinct.

records.source_basis: The retained official October 6 agenda extraction is a header only and does not contain the original term or vote; automated reporting does not establish it.
records.remaining_questions: Recover a record-specific reliable original-term account and resolve original Bill 1061-C.S. adoption and wording; inspect later action separately.

records.source_basis: The October 23 official city bulletin expressly reports the Council initially adopted a 45-day moratorium on September 14. This directly supports the existing numeric fixed-days field as a reported adopted original term.
records.remaining_questions: Exact original operative wording, adopted instrument/version, legal effectiveness and any later changes still require their own evidence. A signed original is one possible source, not a condition for accepting the bulletin’s descriptive day count.

records.source_basis: The certified notice identifies adopted successor 2026-1540 and predecessor 2026-1539 and an additional 10 months 15 days; it does not state the original day count.
records.remaining_questions: Recover reliable record-specific evidence of original 2026-1539 term and adoption/version; review operative wording and effectiveness separately. Technical viewer recovery is pending and excluded.
